Ravi Kapoor (CS): Dropping HelmBridge onboarding call notes 1:1. Putting raw asks here for triage.
Elena Morales (PM): paste them in, thx.
Ravi Kapoor (CS): Raw notes: 
- Ask: tenant-level model freeze + rollout hold (they have quarterly audit windows and want to prevent auto-upgrades).
- Ask: per-route billing tags + downloadable reconciliation CSV (finance wants cost by api route and by env).
- Ask: small "cost forecast" view in Console to estimate monthly spend per route.
- Pain: occasional cold-start spikes for tiny tenants (seen ~200-900ms TTFB tails).
- Pain: private deployment logs strip X-User-ID when traffic goes through their ingress sidecar.
- Request: short enablement playbook + 30m SRE office hours after rollout.
Sophie Li (Eng): Notes on tech: model-freeze = policy flag + pinning at routing layer; small footprint warm-worker pool could mitigate cold-starts; audit header passthrough depends on sidecar TLS termination (might be config only). Need traces + sidecar config.
Daniel Park (Product): From renewal convo: billing CSV and model-freeze are the critical items. Forecast view is helpful but lower priority.
Elena Morales (PM): Proposed prioritization and owners:
- Per-route billing tags + CSV export -> P0 -> owner: Elena Morales -> ETA: 10 business days -> reason: finance/renewal need
- Tenant model-freeze toggle -> P0 -> owner: Daniel Park -> ETA: 3 weeks -> reason: compliance window blocker
- Audit header passthrough spec -> P1 -> owner: Ravi Kapoor -> ETA: 5 business days to spec -> reason: compliance verification
- Warm-worker pilot for tiny tenants -> P1 -> owner: Sophie Li -> ETA: 2 week pilot -> reason: reduce TTFB tail for low-QPS tenants
- Console cost-forecast widget -> P2 -> owner: Product team (Daniel) -> ETA: next quarter -> reason: nice-to-have for finance planning
Sophie Li (Eng): Rough engineering time estimates: CSV backend + S3 export ~3 dev-days; UI mapping ~2 dev-days. Model-freeze backend/policy ~8 dev-days + UI ~4 dev-days. Warm-worker infra pilot ~6 dev-days. Audit header passthrough spec -> quick if just passthrough (1 dev-day), more if signing required (3-4 dev-days).
ci-bot: Created ticket HB-3310: "HelmBridge 34 billing tags & CSV export" assigned to Elena Morales, due in 10 business days.
Ravi Kapoor (CS): Please include acceptance criteria: CSV columns = date (UTC), route, env, token_count, cost_cents, currency, customer_reference. Also timezone handling note.
Elena Morales (PM): Added acceptance criteria to HB-3310. Will write a short PRD and include sample CSV.
Daniel Park (Product): Ill mock the model-freeze flow with RBAC options and attach to HB-3311 (model-freeze). Preview by Fri EOD.
Sophie Li (Eng): Ravi - can you upload a short trace sample and their sidecar config to /customers/helmbridge/onboard so I can validate header flow?
Ravi Kapoor (CS): Uploading traces + config now and scheduling the SRE office hours for next Wed 09:30.
Elena Morales (PM): Also adding a smoke-test prompt set to HB-3310 so CS can validate no regressions post-change. 8 prompts covering short/long/structured.
Ravi Kapoor (CS): Customer also asked for a simple one-page cost justification they can share with procurement  can Product/PM provide a template?
Daniel Park (Product): Ill draft a one-pager template and drop it in the customer folder by Tue.
Sophie Li (Eng): Starting warm-worker scoping tomorrow and will post a short runbook + cost tradeoffs.
Ravi Kapoor (CS): Thanks team  Ill confirm the enablement invite and follow up with HelmBridge after PRD lands. :thumbsup:
Elena Morales (PM): :+1: Ill update roadmap and link tickets.
ci-bot: Comment added to HB-3310: "include smoke-test prompts and CSV schema (UTC date, route, env, token_count, cost_cents, currency, customer_reference)".
